title: APU vs Messiah: tuition, size, location
summary: Azusa Pacific University (APU) versus Messiah University (Messiah). Also searched as Messiah vs APU. Scorecard table is sourced; prose is checked against those facts. UniRepository is not affiliated with either school.

sections.heading: How they differ
paragraphs: Messiah University and Azusa Pacific University (Messiah vs APU) are both private nonprofit institutions, as indicated by their College Scorecard ownership codes. Messiah University is located in Mechanicsburg, while Azusa Pacific University is situated in Azusa. Messiah has an undergraduate enrollment of 2,259 students, compared to Azusa Pacific's 2,759 undergraduates. Tuition for in-state students at Messiah University is $42,240, slightly lower than Azusa Pacific's $44,458. These differences highlight variations in size, location, and cost between Messiah vs APU.

sections.heading: Cost

These figures provide insight into the financial commitments associated with attending each institution, reflecting modest differences in tuition and graduate debt between Messiah vs APU.
